integrity: Exact algebraic proof and independent executable Q(sqrt(2)) identity checks; finite tests are not used to infer infinite spectral claims.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the outer invariant annulus at \(\theta=\pi/8\); full-square spectrum not determined. Comparison with a related 2013 doctoral thesis could not be completed.
title: Cubic frequency law and Koopman spectrum of an integrable polygonal square map
